name: mesurer
description: Inspect, annotate, and give feedback on any live interface

scripts.build: pnpm --filter mesurer build && pnpm --filter mesurer-site build
scripts.check:types: pnpm --filter mesurer typecheck && pnpm --filter mesurer-site exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter mesurer-extension exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:push: pnpm check:types && pnpm build:site && pnpm build:extension
